adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the remove link is guarded by `{{#unless automatic}}...{{/unless}}`, but this template is rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`. Inside an `each` itemView template, the context is the item (a `Discourse.User`) / view, not the outer group controller/model, and `Discourse.User` does not have an `automatic` property. Therefore `automatic` is undefined and `{{#unless automatic}}` will evaluate truthy, rendering the remove link even for automatic groups. Clicking it triggers `removeMember` which calls `DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members.json`, and the server-side `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` returns 422 for automatic groups (`can_not_modify_automatic`).
